tagline: Leading technology integrator providing full life cycle services to the U.S. government
hero_kpi_rationale: The concentration of revenue from the U.S. government (98%) represents the foundation of the business model and the primary driver of financial performance

kpis.name: U.S. Government Revenue Concentration
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue generated from contracts with the U.S. government
kpis.description: The company generates 98% of its total revenue from contracts with U.S. government agencies, either directly as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor
kpis.signal: U.S. government revenue represents 98% of total revenue

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: SAIC employs approximately 23,000 individuals led by an experienced management team

kpis.name: Active Contracts and Task Orders
kpis.explanation: Number of active contracts and task orders
kpis.description: SAIC serves its customers through approximately 1,700 active contracts and task orders, demonstrating a broad customer base and portfolio diversification
kpis.signal: Diversified portfolio of 1,700 active contracts and task orders

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2022-2026) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Dependence on U.S. Government Contracts
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, mentioned at the outset of risk disclosures. Strong language: 98% of revenue, impact on government relationship. Stable context vs N-1. High weighting for macro risk.

risks.title: Reduced U.S. Government Defense Spending
risks.score_rationale: Cited as a major threat with risk of budget stagnation or decline. Concerning language: reduced spending, changes in budgetary priorities. Existential risk to business model. Macro category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Government Contracting
risks.score_rationale: Frequently mentioned in the text, with details on IDIQ, pricing pressure, and bid costs. Language: increased competition, pricing pressure. Less critical than macro risks.

risks.title: Organizational Conflicts of Interest
risks.score_rationale: OCI mentioned in regulatory context. Risk of bid restrictions on certain contracts. Regulatory environment relatively stable.

risks.title: Government Audits and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Major risk with mention of penalties and payment withholdings. Ongoing DCAA/DCMA audits. Language: penalties and sanctions, cost adjustments. Continuous exposure.

risks.title: Cost Estimation Errors on Cost-Plus Contracts
risks.score_rationale: Risk of adjustments due to cost estimation errors. Language: complex and involves significant judgment. Direct impact on profitability but mitigated by established processes.

risks.title: Federal Acquisition Process Reforms
risks.score_rationale: Potential reforms to federal acquisition process. Language: acquisition transformation strategy. Operational impact but not immediate.

risks.title: Government Shutdown and Budget Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Government shut down for 43 days in late 2025. DHS agency currently closed. Language: adverse impact on financial outlook. Immediate and documented risk.

ai_positioning.summary: SAIC identifies artificial intelligence as one of its key offerings. AI is embedded within digital transformation solutions and mission-critical operations across both reporting segments (Defense and Intelligence, Civil). The Innovation Factory includes dedicated teams focused on the development and deployment of AI solutions for government clients.
evidence: Both reportable segments entail the integration of emerging technologies into mission critical operations that modernize and enable national imperatives, including IT modernization, digital engineering, artificial intelligence (AI), mission systems support
The Innovation Factory includes designated teams focused on AI, application development, network services, platforms and cloud, engineering, and cybersecurity
Spending packages may provide additional opportunity in areas of SAIC focus such as digital modernization, cyber, microelectronics support
